From pm-cli PR #108 review of managed pm-changelog@2026.6.4. The breaking-change detector appears to use substring matching, so text like non-breaking fix in a type, tag, or title can be classified as breaking and make --suggest-semver recommend a major bump. Expected: require a real breaking token/signal and avoid negated/common safe-change phrases such as non-breaking.
